definitions.explanation: The act of entering or being admitted to a school or university.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入学|にゅうがく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
{入学|にゅうがく}⟦{式|しき}→〜式：02000_shiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{4月|しがつ}→四月：00668_shigatsu⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The entrance ceremony is in April.

examples.japanese: ⟦{息子|むすこ}→息子：00799_musuko⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{入学|にゅうがく}する⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦ランドセル→ランドセル：11191_randoseru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: My son is entering elementary school next year, so I bought him a school backpack.

notes:
{入学|にゅうがく} means enrollment or entering school. Composed of {入|にゅう} (enter) + {学|がく} (study/school).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {入学|にゅうがく}する: to enroll, enter school
- {入学|にゅうがく}{式|しき}: entrance ceremony
- {入学|にゅうがく}{試験|しけん}: entrance examination
- {入学|にゅうがく}{願書|がんしょ}: application for admission
- {入学|にゅうがく}{金|きん}: enrollment fee

OPPOSITE:
- {卒業|そつぎょう}: graduation

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, the school year starts in April, so {入学|にゅうがく}{式|しき} (entrance ceremonies) are held in spring. Cherry blossoms ({桜|さくら}) are associated with new beginnings in education.

SIMILAR PATTERNS:
- {入社|にゅうしゃ}: joining a company
- {入会|にゅうかい}: joining a club/organization
